name: TMD Hall bar · Mak / Xia structure
description: Kin Fai Mak / Jie Shan (Cornell), Yiyu Xia's devices. Ti/Pt electrodes are pre-patterned on the chip as two columns of parallel fingers with a long thin gap between the columns. The whole stack (cap, TG, thin hBN, WSe2, bottom hBN, graphite BG) is released with the BG in the gap, never touching the Pt. The WSe2 is wider than the bottom hBN, so it reaches past the hBN edge onto the finger tips of both columns and stays gated in between. Source and drain are the end fingers of the two columns (Hall bar › S/D 'Bent to the sides'; W is the gap between the columns). Contact gates and split gates are written on top; the top gate is smaller than the bottom gate and defines the channel. Layout as described by the lab on 2026-11-16.

process: EBL + evaporation of the Ti/Pt electrodes on the chip: two columns of fingers with a thin gap between them for the BG.   [UStack Stage 2: prepattern contacts]
Exfoliate hBN, graphite and monolayer WSe2; cut the WSe2 in half with an AFM tip.
PC on PDMS picks up, in order: hBN cap, TG graphite, thin hBN, half 1, half 2 (twisted), bottom hBN, BG graphite.
Release at 200 °C (Xia 2024; 180 °C for MoTe2, Kang 2025) with the BG in the gap between the electrode columns; the WSe2 reaches past the bottom hBN onto the finger tips.
EBL + evaporation of the contact gates and split gates.   [UStack Stage 2: contact gates + split gates]
